messages:
maria: Quick checkpoint — continuous batching rollout, week 2. Kernel changes merged but we saw p95 spikes when KV eviction runs. Owners: @vikram (kernel), @carla (infra). Need blockers/ETA and whether we can widen the canary window.

vikram: Yep, I saw the spikes. Root cause looks like lock contention on the cold-path during eviction bursts. PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5123. Running perf harness now. :mag:

carla: Infra note — staging is running the new eviction cron right now; it overlaps with our GC window which amplifies thrash. I'll throttle the cron to off-peak for the next run. If kernel fix is >1 day we should change schedule permanently.

eli: I opened a small change that helps KV prefetch heuristics (branch: kv-prefetch-opt). Should reduce eviction frequency and smoother steady state. CC @vikram. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5130

tonY: Can we get a quick dashboard snapshot (p95, CPU, eviction_rate) for the canary? Also what's the explicit rollback plan if p95 regresses? :eyes:

maria: Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood-inference/runtime/s/rollouts?orgId=1 :thumbsup: Rollback plan: auto-fallback to the smaller-batch kernel variant + increase cache size via /configs/canary.json. Ops playbook shortlink: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RT/rollout-playbook

vikram: Local synthetic traces show p95 down from ~420ms -> ~210ms with my patch. Still need staging run. Will mark PR 5123 "ready-for-stage" after one more test.

carla: Heads up — staging nodes need kernel-rt v2 driver for the new path; that upgrade takes ~2 hours maintenance. If we need an extra staging pass we should schedule it. Shout if that blocks rollout.

eli: Quick ask — can someone review kv-prefetch-opt? Small change, perf numbers in PR description. @carla please check infra implications as well.

vikram: Reviewed, left one comment about atomic ordering in the hot loop. I'll push the fix tonight. @maria can we extend the canary window by +2h so we get one extra overnight pass?

maria: +1 to extension, doing that now. Also filed dependency ticket ENG-RT-789 to capture infra driver requirement: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-RT-789

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-17T09:20 — validated canary deploy to staging for commit abc123. status: success.

tonY: Thanks — I'll watch alerts and pager. If we see >10% p95 regressions revert to previous canary and escalate to infra.

maria: Sounds good. Plan: if no blockers tomorrow we target full rollout Thu morning. Anything else blocking?

vikram: No blockers from kernel side after I push the tiny fix.

eli: No blockers, just pending reviews.

carla: I'll schedule kernel-rt prep for Wed evening and post a short runbook in the ticket.

maria: Great — thanks everyone. Follow-ups: PRs 5123 & 5130, ENG-RT-789, canary window extended +2h. Reaction: :eyes: for watchers.
